title: Saltmere Harbour
changes: Saltmere has grown into a proper fishing village: a new Upper Lane with The Gull & Anchor tavern, a chandlery and a smokehouse, three more cottages, and Harbour Street running from the waystone down to the pier.
Saltmere's new flagstone harbour square, between the two piers, is a safe zone.
Short jetties now reach out into the water at Gullrock Cove and on Heronwreck Strand.
